title: Crosslinking Immunoprecipitation Beads
author: Bryon Drown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdhki34w
materials: Form complex with beads and antibody
Prepare fresh triethanolamine and ethanolamine buffers. DMP should be added to Crosslinking Buffer immediately before use.

steps.title: Add binding buffer and beads
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL Binding Buffer and 100 µL magnetic beads to a 1.5 mL LoBind tube.

steps.title: Collect and resuspend beads
steps.instruction: Collect the beads with a DynaMag‑2 magnet (Invitrogen, cat #12321D) and resuspend them in 900 µL Binding Buffer.

steps.title: Add IgG antibody
steps.instruction: Add 50 µg IgG antibody to the bead suspension.

steps.title: Incubate overnight with rotation
steps.instruction: Incubate the tube on a tube rotator (Fisher, cat #88861051) at 4 °C with continuous rotation overnight.

steps.title: Wash beads with TEA buffer
steps.instruction: Collect the beads with the magnet, discard the supernatant, and wash the beads with 1 mL TEA Wash Buffer.

steps.title: Crosslink beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the beads in 1 mL Crosslinking Buffer and incubate at ambient (room) temperature for 1 hour while rotating.

steps.title: Quench crosslinking
steps.instruction: Collect the beads with the magnet, immediately wash with 1 mL Quenching Buffer, then resuspend in 1 mL Quenching Buffer and incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes while rotating.

steps.title: Sequential washes and elution
steps.instruction: Collect beads with the magnet and perform the following washes (repeat the entire sequence twice): 1 mL TEA Wash Buffer, 1 mL Basic Elution Buffer, 1 mL Acidic Elution Buffer, and 1 mL TBS.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 1 mL TEA Wash Buffer
Wash with 1 mL Basic Elution Buffer
Wash with 1 mL Acidic Elution Buffer

steps.title: Store beads
steps.instruction: Resuspend the final bead pellet in 1 mL Storage Buffer and store at 4 °C.
